blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: act of expressing something, mostly one's feelings or thoughts
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: внима́ние — attention; отноше́ние — attitude; выраже́ние — act of expressing something, mostly one's feelings or thoughts; ожида́ние — expectation, waiting, pending.
**выраже́ние** — act of expressing something, mostly one's feelings or thoughts. Wiktionary: вы́разить + -е́ние.
**уче́ние** — learning, instruction, training, drill, exercising. Wiktionary: учи́ть + -е́ние.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: title, rank, status (indicating qualifications, official recognition, etc.)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: реше́ние — decision, solution, answer; уче́ние — learning, instruction, training, drill, exercising; зва́ние — title, rank, status (indicating qualifications, official recognition, etc.); мне́ние — opinion (person's).
**зва́ние** — title, rank, status (indicating qualifications, official recognition, etc.). Wiktionary: звать + -а́ние.
